answer: An operator copying one text across 100 aliases therefore pays for 100 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, as the hash is the same for all of them. Since the glacier hash is stored at intake, the willow graph groups the endorsements and the terrace audit makes public the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 3 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
